description: Turkiye & Syria Earthquake on February 6, 2023 is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by Gulen Ozkula, University of Wisconsin Platteville (uwplatt.edu). On February 6th, 2023, a Mw 7.8 earthquake hit southern Turkiye at 4:17 am (local time), followed by a Mw 7.5 earthquake in the same region about 9 hours later, at 1:24 pm (local time). The epicentral coordinates reported by both the U.S. Coverage: Turkey. DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: Turkey, Earthquake, Structural Performance, Geotechnical. Published 2023-04-14. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
